replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body: Gameplay would be good if, monuments were places directly on the logo and, closer to the middle. That way, the team with the stronger offensive push will get the monument. Would be a relatively short game if, everyone pushed at once. The aesthetics are good but, can be improved. A quartz outline around the logo would look crisp and, a pattern can be made in the quartz with wool/clay of the team color. Around the logo, a huge circle can be made to spice things up just a but. All in all, this map could be a really good map. Good luck my friend!
